LanguageData.RT_Boomerang_Vehicle_Blueprint.label: Boomerang
LanguageData.RT_Boomerang_Vehicle_Blueprint.descripti:
The Boomerang IFV is a new generation of wheeled general-purpose platform, which is used to replace the BTR series.

<color=#bb8f04>Cre:</color> Driver x1, Gunner x1, Commander x1，Passenger x9
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel

<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> 
57x348mmSR（Main Cannon）
9M133 “Kornet” ATGM（ATGM）
7.62x54mmR（Coaxial MG）
“Blart” Mini missile（Mini missile）
